text: Frontend data layer: load the whole project once and keep it live via pushed entities
description: Audit finding (2026-09-28). The full graph (753 ideas / 34 phases, 1.1MB) loads via idea.list in ~100-150ms, yet the frontend loads lazily per parent/phase: 55 call sites of loadPhases/loadPhaseIdeas/loadIdeas/loadFloatingIdeas, promise caches (phaseChildrenLoadPromises, loadedPhaseChildrenByParentId), ensureColumnNeighborhoodLoaded, 'missing ideas' top-ups in the subscription handler. Correctness bug: loadProject only loads floating ideas + phases, and the full idea set only arrives when GraphView mounts, so recalculateValues computes list-view value/cost/priority over a partial graph. Target: loadProject = meta + phase.list + idea.list (IndexedDB cache first), subscription always carries the entity, delete all lazy-load paths and their guards. Step 1: load all ideas in loadProject.

status.comment: Committed; vitest 234/234, backend 70/70, e2e 19/19, type checks clean. Awaiting Felix's check that the list view feels right (values correct without opening the graph, edits from agents appear live).
